ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

3. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

4. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.

5. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.

6. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.

7. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.

8. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.

9. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. going
   C. goed
   D. went

12. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only an action

13. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

14. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.

15. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
